description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.
 
 This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing.  By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.
 
 This Position reports to:
Project Office Manager 
 
 Your role and responsibilities 

 Working as a Project Engineer, you will be the support person for various projects in  ABB Robotics   in Bursa; Türkiye, providing technical details, costs and deliverables for sales   proposals . You will make technical recommendations in various phases of customer projects to ensure successful delivery of project deliverables on time, within budget and in line with quality and   safety guidelines . 

The work model for the role is: {onsite} 

You will be mainly accountable for:
 Responsible for offline and   online robot programming, s imulation   of designed tools and equipment,
 Making the reachability studies of tools and robots in ABB 3D   RobotStudio   software,
 Preparing documentations for   design   output,
 Having and pro-active role in   supply chain   for the   mechanical   parts ABB procures from suppliers starting from selection until   quality control   processes,
 Leading on- site commissioning   and verifying virtual simulations,
 Carrying out commissioning studies by actively accompanying the projects local and abroad,
 Following   manufacturing , assembly and start-up phases of designed equipments to   ensure quality   and functionality,
 Preparing documentations for ABB standards,
 Supporting   R&D projects   and developing new robotic cells,
 Represent ABB during site visits, communicating at all levels to ensure   customer satisfaction ,
 Assist salespeople during customer visits when necessary.
 
 

 Qualifications for the role University degree in   Engineering   degree (Mechatronic, Control & Automation),
 Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in   Robotics , welding , fixture and commissionining processes,
 Knowledge of industrial robot   operations ,
 Preferably have process knowledge in one or more disciplines such as   welding ,   material handling , paint, press automation, picking/packing/palletizing, camera   applications   etc. is a plus,
 Experience in ABB Robots is a definite plus,
 Experience in offline robot programming and   simulation   packages ( RobotStudio ) is a plus.
 Automation, picking/packing/palletizing, camera   applications   etc. is a plus
 Advanced level of English skills,
 Innovative,   team   player and highly motivated profile with strong   interpersonal   skills,
 No limitation for   travel   and working in customer site local and in abroad,
 
 
 
 We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
